articles.title: This Plane Is So Quiet It Goes 'Thump' Instead of 'BOOM'!
articles.summary: NASA's X-59 plane just did wild flips and turns in the sky, hitting 730 mph without a big sonic boom. It's designed to make a soft 'thump' like a car door closing, which could bring back super-fast flights.

articles.title: Scientists Just Made Weird New Matter That Shouldn't Exist!
articles.summary: By flipping magnetic fields on and off like a light switch, scientists created exotic quantum states never seen before. This could lead to super-powered computers that don't crash.

articles.title: Life's Secret Ingredient 3 Billion Years Ago? A Super Rare Metal!
articles.summary: Ancient life on Earth used molybdenum, a metal that was almost impossible to find back then. Scientists say this shows life can thrive with scarce resources — and maybe aliens do too.
